summary: Rare and Xbox's combo-heavy fighting series; use the Xbox Classic arcade ports for KI1/KI2, Rare Replay/Nintendo Classics for Gold, and the Anniversary Edition for the 2013 reboot.

entries.title: Killer Instinct

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation only for cabinet comparison.

primary.why: Killer Instinct Classic is the arcade version with added training, galleries/cutscenes, filters, revision selection, and later online multiplayer.
primary.how_to_play: Play Killer Instinct Classic through the Xbox One/Series ecosystem as bundled with the 2013 Killer Instinct content; use SNES/Nintendo Classics only for the console-port experience.

entries.remaster_caveats: SNES/Game Boy ports are separate conversion experiences but not the main route.

entries.title: Killer Instinct 2

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation only for cabinet comparison.

primary.why: Killer Instinct 2 Classic is the official arcade-version route bundled with Killer Instinct's second season on Xbox.
primary.how_to_play: Play Killer Instinct 2 Classic on Xbox One/Series; play Killer Instinct Gold separately if you want the N64-specific port and modes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate with Killer Instinct Gold's N64-specific content and limitations.

entries.title: Killer Instinct Gold
entries.definitive_edition: Rare Replay version for Gold-specific play

emulation.emulator: Rare Replay / Nintendo Classics; N64 emulator fallback
emulation.notes: Use original N64 only for hardware comparison.

primary.why: Gold is the Nintendo 64-specific version of KI2 with team modes, practice mode, camera views, and console-specific compromises; Rare Replay is the best Xbox access route.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Rare Replay on Xbox One/Series or Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack if you want the Nintendo Classics route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Gold is a console version of KI2, not the arcade-perfect KI2 route.

entries.title: Killer Instinct

primary.why: The modern Killer Instinct reboot is available on Xbox and Windows, and the Anniversary Edition consolidates the character/content updates while PC has the highest fidelity ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Anniversary Edition on Windows PC; use Xbox Series X/S if you prefer console play and cross-play ecosystem.

entries.remaster_caveats: Ongoing-service style fighting game; preserve current Anniversary Edition content package.
